dataset: PyThaiNLP/Wisesight Sentiment Corpus with Word Tokenization Label
citation: Suriyawongkul et al. (2024), PyThaiNLP/Wisesight Sentiment Corpus with Word Tokenization Label, Zenodo, https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.3457446
source_annotation: Human word-tokenization labels published by the upstream dataset; the source paper describes manual segmentation using the Aroonmanakun (2007) word-segmentation standard.
reason_not_1000: The upstream tokenized label file has 993 records; source literature notes seven spam messages were removed from the nominal 1,000-sample set.

conversion.tokens: Each line is split on |; zero-length fields are discarded because they contribute no text; remaining tokens are joined without modification.
conversion.invariant: For every row, concatenating gold tokens exactly reproduces the stored text.
conversion.split_note: The upstream corpus does not publish a formal train/test split for this annotation file. The full 993-row snapshot is designated test-only for this repository and must not be used for training or lexicon construction.
conversion.limitations: Source-annotated human segmentation; no claim of independent expert adjudication, inter-annotator agreement, or representative coverage of Standard Thai.
